verdict.rationale: A guided first-time workspace setup walkthrough is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like monday.com, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an onboarding wizard, setup tour or guided walkthrough. The items on free-plan signup, describing a workflow to create an agent, and monday vibe app generation are adjacent features, not a guided workspace setup flow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
